structured.answer: I'd open a Pesagot account and buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 tracker fund (ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), number 5139282). It's the one marked "הזול" (cheapest), with an account fee of 1,057 ₪ over 10 years and 0% fund fee. The page says about 86,500 ₪ after 10 years, but that's for 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month, not my 30,000.

stuck.where: Amount fields at the top (סכום היום 10,000)
stuck.why: Left at the page's 10,000 instead of my 30,000, so the 86,492 ₪ result isn't really mine
At 7% for 10 years I expected about 70% more, so the gain looked too small. I guessed 'בכסף של היום' (in today's money) has something to do with it
Pesagot is marked cheapest, but Leumi is my kind of name and only ~3,000 ₪ less, so I hesitated

stuck.where: מול המדד column in the fund list
stuck.why: Numbers like +0.37% with 'שנה אחת' didn't tell me if that's good or bad

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Fund card: ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), דמי ניהול 0%
Account card: פסגות, 'מה החשבון גובה ב־10 שנים: 1,057 ₪'
skimmed: Rest of the fund list (other S&P 500 trackers with minus shekel numbers)
Rest of the account list down to ~63,000
skipped: Coloured cost bar and legend (עמלות קנייה ומכירה, דמי משמרת…)
Foreign ETFs rows (iShares, Vanguard, 'אין מחיר כאן')
'למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות' explanation
Inflation line with dollar rate and date
not_found: A clear 'first step: do this' instruction
An easy way to set my own amount (30,000) that I'd actually touch

findings.what: Result is for the page's default 10,000 + 500/month, not the user's own amount, and nothing pushes you to change it
86,492 from 70,000 at 7% looks surprisingly small; 'בכסף של היום' isn't explained right there
Too many tags on each fund row (צוברת, עקבת החלף, חשיפה לדולר, מס גם על שינוי המטבע…), meaningless noise for a beginner
Cheapest account is not a household bank name, which makes a beginner hesitate; nothing reassures about it
Wide range with minus signs 'בין +2,212 ל־ −23,766' is scary and unclear
Lots of foreign ETF rows with 'אין מחיר כאן' clutter the list
No single summary line 'open X, buy Y, end with Z'
